endianness: Qubit 0 is least significant; output-register integers match q[n-1]...q[0].
oracle_accounting: Logical oracle query counts differ from decomposed gate count, circuit construction, transpilation and simulator CPU time. Grover charges r search calls plus one verification call; sample success is retained.
qml: Same transformed features, train/test split, C=1 and precomputed-kernel SVC. Quantum kernel uses explicit compute-uncompute Statevector circuits, upper-triangle train Gram and full test Gram. No amplitude-cache shortcut in measured kernel construction.
noise: Historical 2024-05-27 FakeManila calibration, Aer density-matrix shots, paired ideal control on identical transpiled circuits. No physical QPU execution or current calibration claim.
sampling: Algorithm-suite counts are classical Born draws from SDK statevectors. Only the calibrated/paired noise study uses actual Aer shot execution. Kernel-shot sensitivity is synthetic binomial test-kernel noise with ideal-trained SVC, not noisy training.
reuse: Unchanged earlier C/D summaries/protocols/audit are included with hashes; they are earlier measurements, not fresh Track I executions.
